messages:
sam.sre: FYI team: scheduling a short fallback-and-warmup drill for eu-central-1 this Thursday 04:30-05:00 UTC. Purpose: validate KV prefix warmup + automated model fallback under controlled cold-cache conditions.

priya.platform: What's the expected customer impact?

sam.sre: Low risk. We'll only run a 3% canary first. Expected visible effect: occasional 100-300ms p95 blips for requests missing cache while warmup runs. No planned errors; fallback to smaller model variant if latency > SLO for 2 consecutive minutes.

leo.prod: Can we add a synthetic smoke test for the public SDKs during the drill?

sam.sre: yes — will trigger smoke after warmup completes at each ramp. Plan: 1) warmup canary prefixes 5m before canary, 2) canary 3% for 10m with warmup running, 3) ramp to 20% for 10m, 4) short overload pulse (internal loadgen) for 5m to test fallback logic, then observe 5m.

ops-bot: Abort criteria: gen-api error rate >0.3% OR p95 delta >350ms sustained for 8m OR fallback-count >100 in a 5m window.

priya.platform: Runbook excerpt for engineers:
```
# enable warmup for prefixes
curl -X POST https://internal-api/kv/warmup -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prefixes":["/gen-cache/","/session/ctx/"]}'
# trigger fallback override (if needed)
curl -X POST https://internal-api/config/fallback -d '{"region":"eu-central-1","force":true}'
```

deploy-bot: maintenance job scheduled: job_id=drill-2026-05-07-euc1-1969998765, canary=3%

infra-bot: Capacity check: GPU pools euc1 standard at 15% spare — OK for canary and pulse.

leo.prod: I'll queue the SDK smoke tests and watch results. Hannah, can support triage customer reports if any?

hannah.support: Yep, I'll stand by and coordinate with product-ops for any public messages.

sam.sre: Monitoring: priya will own dashboards (kv-hitrate, gen-api-p95, fallback-rate), leo owns smoke tests. We'll post to #status if we hit abort.

priya.platform: I'll add alert thresholds matching abort criteria and create a temporary dashboard tab.

sam.sre: Reminder: this is a drill — please don't escalate normal short-lived blips unless they meet abort criteria. If you want to opt-out your service, DM me before Wed 23:59 UTC.

deploy-bot: Reminder set: 1h before window.

sam.sre: thanks. I'll post final job id and exact warmup prefixes 30m before start. :white_check_mark:
